title: Faster Evia and consistent AC coverage
details: Removed continuous Home, ARP, camera and assessor-observation polling that was slowing Evia down
Home AC now uses the same total coverage as the AC menu: learner evidence, RPL and Milos-observed ACs all count as covered
The Milos observed count and blue observed markers remain inside the AC/KSB coverage menus rather than on the Home screen
ARP remains at 0% until an Assessment Readiness & Practice attempt has actually been made
Screen updates now run only when the relevant part of Evia changes
